professionalSummary.text: Three‑year mortgage underwriting analyst with experience preparing assessments for ~700 applications annually, verifying income and property documents, handling adviser escalations, referring out‑of‑policy cases, and documenting open items and hand‑over conditions.
professionalSummary.witness: "Mortgage underwriting analyst in a retail bank's residential lending team for three years, preparing the underwriting assessments for about seven hundred applications a year against the lending policy under the assessment procedure."

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared underwriting assessments for ~700 applications per year, ensuring compliance with lending policy and assessment procedure.
experienceHighlights.witness: "preparing the underwriting assessments for about seven hundred applications a year against the lending policy under the assessment procedure."

experienceHighlights.text: Verified income and property documents using a standardized checklist for every application.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Verified the income and property documents on each application under the verification standard, with the verification checklist completed on each case file."

experienceHighlights.text: Explained declined or conditioned outcomes to mortgage advisers, managing escalations and maintaining records.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Explained the declined and conditioned outcomes to the mortgage advisers on the adviser line, with the adviser escalations logged; eleven escalations in three years, none upheld against the assessment."

experienceHighlights.text: Referred out‑of‑policy or above‑mandate cases to senior underwriters, documenting referral reasons and mandate boundaries.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Referred the cases outside policy or above my mandate to the senior underwriter, recording the referral reason and the mandate on each case."

experienceHighlights.text: Documented open items and hand‑over conditions for each case passed to another analyst or senior underwriter.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Wrote the open items note and the hand-over conditions on each case passed to another analyst or to the senior underwriter."

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided two anonymised case files, including assessment, verification checklist, adviser call note, referral record, and adviser escalation log extract, demonstrating full underwriting workflow.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: "Work sample: two anonymised case files (assessment, verification checklist, adviser call note, referral record) and the adviser escalation log extract, with the underwriting system references as a verification trail."
